about_short_description.short_description: Buildzoom is a construction project consultancy that provides building renovation services using data and analysis processes.

product.name: Contractor Matching Service
product.description: A service that matches clients with local, experienced contractors based on project details and preferences.

product.name: Project Consultant Support
product.description: Dedicated project consultants guide clients through contractor selection and project planning.

product.name: BuildZoom Premium Service
product.description: A paid service offering extended guidance during the pre-construction phase of home improvement projects.

product.name: Contractor Communication and Document Management
product.description: A platform feature that organizes all communications, notes, and documents between clients and contractors in one place.

product.name: Construction Data and Analysis
product.description: Utilizes extensive building permit and contractor license data to inform contractor matching and project insights.
